title: Historical Account of the Introduction of the Galvanic and Electro-Magnetic Telegraph into England
lineage: 1859 account is an explicitly partisan priority argument for Schilling. Its claims about an identical device being imported were disputed by Cooke; do not equate the actual instruments.

passages.note: Sections tracing Oersted and Ampere’s needle-signal proposal through Schilling, Muncke and Cooke; final account explicitly dates establishment of the Blackwall line to 1840.
